title: Erasure of Unaligned Attributes from Neural Representations

bias_targets.methodology: Evaluated using word embedding projections (e.g., he-she direction), True Positive Rate gap (TPR-GAP) in profession prediction (BiasBios dataset), Mean Absolute Error Gap (MAEGap) in sentiment analysis, and stereotype association scores from the BiasBench benchmark (CrowS-Pairs, StereoSet, and SEAT).

Assessed via stereotype scores and effect sizes from BiasBench datasets (CrowS-Pairs, StereoSet, SEAT), and by evaluating classification performance while removing ethnic affiliation information distinguishing African-American English (AAE) from Standard American English (SAE) in tweets.
Measured using language model stereotype scores and sentence-level association tests (effect sizes) from the BiasBench benchmark datasets (CrowS-Pairs, StereoSet, and SEAT).
Evaluated by calculating the Mean Absolute Error Gap (MAEGap) across different age groups in a continuous sentiment prediction task on a Twitter dataset.
